lines: Ninety-one blocks. A bad year is four hundred, and I have ninety-one.
Aureline has an order in for three hundred and I have not written back yet.
Nine days of not writing back. I have never done that in my life.
Two walls, two feet of sawdust between them, and no window anywhere. That is it.
That is the whole invention. A box that keeps the dark cold, for eight hundred years.
People come up from the capital expecting machinery. There is a door and some straw.
Straw between every course, and never let two blocks touch. They weld if they touch.
You get one shed of welded ice in your life and you never manage it twice.
